CLPoolManager and BinPoolManager are singleton pool managers (all pools inside a single contract); no separate factory child-enumeration needed. Pool creation goes through the pool manager's initialize() function. Cap notice not required as there is no discrete factory-children enumeration.

protocol_metadata.about: PancakeSwap Infinity is a modular decentralized exchange protocol deployed on BNB Smart Chain and Base, where users swap tokens and provide liquidity through concentrated liquidity (CL) and liquidity book (Bin) pool types. A singleton Vault contract holds all token balances while separate CLPoolManager and BinPoolManager contracts handle AMM logic, enabling new pool types to be added without redeploying the custody layer. The architecture supports customizable Hooks—external smart contracts that attach bespoke logic (dynamic fees, limit orders, custom oracles) to individual pools at creation time. A UniversalRouter aggregates routing across all pool types and legacy PancakeSwap versions in a single transaction.
